title: ClawEnvKit: Automatic Environment Generation for AI Agents
summary: An autonomous toolkit for generating and validating environments for tool-using AI agents. It automates the creation of task specifications, tool interfaces, and continuous scoring configurations to enable scalable benchmarking.
research_notes: Achieves human-level quality in benchmark generation with a 13,800x reduction in cost and time compared to manual curation.

evolution.summary: Evolved from a research tool for the 1,040-task Auto-ClawEval benchmark into a general-purpose toolkit supporting Model Context Protocol (MCP) and on-the-fly environment generation for agent debugging.
